scope_notes.blocks: SPLIT/FRONT/BLOCKS work kinds: FRONT handles blocks and bodies in propagation order.
scope_notes.damage_stage: ExplosionStage.DAMAGE includes the entire front() loop (blocks and bodies) as well as damage(); it is not an entity-damage-only timer.
scope_notes.mobs: irradiated means accumulated dose>0. RadiationDose rate/contamination are player-only fields in Incoming3.10.4 and stay zero on mobs; not a fallout-work detector.
scope_notes.timers: Wall stopwatches on the server thread; stages are nested details of parts, not additional cost.

air.note: Wall stopwatch includes its own end guard/timer overhead; server Air.of numeric overload only, not client LocalWind.
